title: Blocking Async Executors
pattern: Calling a synchronous, blocking OS function (like sleeping or synchronous file/network I/O) directly within an asynchronous task.
why_bad: Executor starvation. Cooperative multitasking systems rely on tasks yielding voluntarily. Blocking blocks the executor thread itself, stalling all other tasks on that thread.
detection: Invoking known synchronous blocking functions inside an `async fn` or `Future::poll` block.
counterexample: Invoking blocking operations inside standard synchronous threads or dedicated background threads.
source: Jon Gjengset, *Rust For Rustaceans*, Chapter 9 "Blocking in Async Code".
